title: Northgate+ Free Trial: Offer, Conversion and Free Cancellation
content:
**Offer.** A free trial of a tier of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships is offered only on a tier whose free trial length is greater than zero, and only when the customer's recent paid fee count is zero, that is, no membership fee settled for the customer within the tier's look-back months before the enrollment date. The recent paid fee count is the number of settled membership fee charges on any membership record of the same customer dated within the look-back months ending on the enrollment date, inclusive of both ends. Where the tier requires a payment method for a trial, a payment method must be on file at enrollment. A customer whose recent fee count is above zero enrolls directly into the paid term with no trial.

**Running and conversion.** The trial starts on the enrollment date, and the trial end date is the enrollment date plus the tier's free trial days, in calendar days. On the trial end date the membership converts to active, the trial end date becomes the term start date and the first fee is charged under the membership fee charging rule. A trial gives the full benefits of the tier and each benefit applied is recorded as a benefit use like any paid term.

**Free cancellation — time gate.** A trial can be canceled free of charge only when the cancellation date is earlier than the enrollment date plus the tier's free trial days. Calendar days are added to the enrollment date, the day after enrollment being day 1, and the cancellation date must fall strictly before the resulting date. A cancellation request made on or after that date is handled as a cancellation of the converted paid membership under the membership cancellation rule.

- Clock start: the enrollment date on the membership record.
- Counting: calendar days, the day after enrollment being day 1.
- Comparison: the cancellation date must be strictly earlier than the resulting date; the resulting date itself does not qualify.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical 30-day trial, enrollment on 1 May 2031)**

| Cancellation date | Position against the resulting date (31 May 2031) | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 30 May 2031 | before | free trial cancellation, never charged |
| 31 May 2031 | on the resulting date | cancellation of the converted paid membership |

**Questions answered by the rule**

*A customer had a settled Northgate+ Monthly fee nine months before enrolling in Northgate+ Annual.* With a 12-month look-back the recent fee count is above zero, so the customer enrolls directly into the paid term with no trial.

*Does an order delivered during the trial use the member benefits?* Yes; the trial gives the full benefits of the tier and the use is recorded like any paid term.
